dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A bundled family for dimensions m and n, containing an exact matrix A, positive-precision runs producing Q and R data, fixed norm bounds and validity radii, and proofs of the conditions listed by its constructor D019.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all fixed input data, computed runs, bounds, radii, and embedded assumptions quantified over by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection family.run, sending a positive real precision epsilonM to the corresponding run record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the Q, R, and leading-inverse data at the precision used in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Q-matrix projection from a run record; it is an m by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its leading k+1 columns form the computed Q prefix whose orthogonality defect is bounded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The R-matrix projection from a run record; it is an n by n real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its leading principal k+1 block occurs in the first-order condition factor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each k, the run's supplied inverse of the leading k+1 principal block of R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its operator norm is multiplied by the norm of the leading R block and then squared in the first-order term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The subtype of real numbers epsilonM satisfying 0 < epsilonM.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts the precision parameter to be strictly positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: A bundled second-order analysis for a family, containing three nonnegative coefficient functions, a positive radius, and the residual and norm inequalities in D026.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the analysis radius and the three second-order coefficients used in the quadratic remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real constant c(m,p) = beta(m,p) + 2 alpha(m,p), where alpha is D030 and beta is D032.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the coefficient multiplying both the first-order condition term and part of the quadratic remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by n matrix and k in Fin n, the submatrix consisting of its first k+1 columns, represented as an m by k+1 matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the leading prefixes A_k and Q_k used throughout the assumptions and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: For two square matrices of the same size, the product of their Euclidean operator norms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to the leading R block and its supplied inverse, it gives the condition proxy whose square appears in the first-order error term.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an n by n matrix R and k in Fin n, its leading k+1 by k+1 principal submatrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It extracts the R prefix used in the assumptions, condition factor, and inverse identities.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean induced operator norm of a real square matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the orthogonality defect and the norms of R prefixes and their inverses.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by p matrix Q, the p by p Gram defect I_p - QᵀQ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The left side of the target is the operator norm of this defect for the computed leading Q prefix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The common admissible radius rho = min(1, family.normBoundRadius, family.conditionRadius, analysis.radius).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The explicit hypothesis requires epsilonM ≤ rho, activating all bundled local estimates and also ensuring epsilonM ≤ 1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: For p=k+1, a=‖A_k‖, fixed bounds r̄_k and b̄_k, factorization coefficient f_k, normal-equation coefficient g_k, and reverse-norm coefficient h_k, it is b̄_k²[c(m,p)(2r̄_k s_k+s_k²)+g_k+2af_k+(alpha(m,p)a+f_k)²], where s_k=(beta(m,p)/2)r̄_k+h_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is exactly the coefficient of epsilonM² on the right side of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of the family's fixed m by n matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its leading prefixes determine the norms entering the quadratic coefficient and the analysis assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The family's positive condition radius.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is included in rho and is the range on which the smallness condition for every R prefix is available.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The family's fixed inverse-norm bound b̄_k for each leading inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square multiplies the entire quadratic remainder coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for a family from A; a run at every positive epsilon with the same A; nonnegative R-prefix and inverse-prefix norm bounds; positive norm and condition radii; corresponding norm bounds below the norm radius; and c(m,k+1) epsilon (‖R_k‖‖B_k‖)² < 1 below the condition radius.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes these data and universally quantified hypotheses part of every family value used by the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The family's positive norm-bound radius.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is included in rho and activates the fixed upper bounds on ‖R_k‖ and ‖B_k‖.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: The family's fixed nonnegative bound r̄_k on the norm of each leading R block.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in the quadratic coefficient through s_k and 2r̄_ks_k+s_k².

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: A run record at dimensions m,n and real precision epsilon, containing dimension conditions, A,Q,R, arithmetic data, leading inverses, and per-column computation certificates as specified by D040.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It packages the computed matrices and inverse blocks from which the target's run-dependent quantities are projected.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of n by n real matrices indexed by Fin n in both dimensions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of R, its leading blocks and inverses, Gram defects, and normal-equation residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of m by n real matrices indexed by Fin m and Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of A, Q, their prefixes, and factorization residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The analysis projection f_k giving the factorization-residual second-order coefficient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters the quadratic remainder as 2‖A_k‖f_k and (alpha‖A_k‖+f_k)².

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for an analysis package with nonnegative f_k,g_k,h_k and positive radius, assuming below that radius: ‖Q_kR_k-A_k‖ ≤ alpha(m,p)‖A_k‖epsilon+f_kepsilon²; ‖R_kᵀR_k-A_kᵀA_k‖ ≤ beta(m,p)‖A_k‖²epsilon+g_kepsilon²; and ‖A_k‖ ≤ (1+(beta(m,p)/2)epsilon)‖R_k‖+h_kepsilon².
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These three inequalities are the embedded analytical hypotheses from which the orthogonality bound and its exact quadratic coefficient are formed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: The analysis projection g_k giving the normal-equation-residual second-order coefficient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes additively to the core quadratic remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: The positive radius of validity of the analysis estimates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is included in the minimum rho required of epsilonM.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: The analysis projection h_k giving the reverse-norm second-order coefficient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes to s_k=(beta/2)r̄_k+h_k in the quadratic coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constant alpha(m,p), equal to 1 when p=1 and otherwise 2√2·m·p + 2√p, with natural numbers cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the first-order factorization residual and appears in c(m,p) and the squared core remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1+1=2 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 2 and adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constant beta(m,p), equal to m+2 when p=1 and otherwise (7/2)mp²-(3/2)mp+16p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It controls the normal-equation residual, defines beta/2 and c=beta+2alpha, and enters the quadratic coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constant beta(m,p)/2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first-order slope in the reverse-norm estimate and in s_k.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: The identity matrix I_n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the Gram defect and the two-sided inverse equations for leading R blocks.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k in Fin n, a proof that k+1 ≤ n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies embedding k+1-sized indices into n-sized matrices when taking leading prefixes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real matrix multiplication for compatible rectangular matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q_kR_k, A_kᵀA_k, and related residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean induced operator norm of a real rectangular matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures A prefixes and factorization residuals in the embedded analysis and quadratic coefficient.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms QᵀQ and AᵀA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: The A-matrix projection from a run record.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The family constructor requires this run matrix to equal the family's fixed A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for a run requiring m>0, n>0, n≤m, an injective matrix map A, an upper-triangular R, a modeled arithmetic, exact two-sided inverses B_k of every leading R block, and certified per-column computations producing Q and R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees that every quantified run is dimensionally valid, has full-column-rank input, has invertible leading R blocks, and arises from the certified computation model.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 6+1=7 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 7 in beta and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 2+1=3 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 3 in beta and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 15+1=16 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 16 in beta and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: For A and a square R of matching column dimension, the normal-equation residual RᵀR-AᵀA.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its operator norm is bounded by the second analysis inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a family run and prefix k, the factorization residual Q_kR_k-A_k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its operator norm is bounded by the first analysis inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: A per-column computation certificate for given arithmetic, A, Q, R, and column k, with its constructor detailed in D050.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It certifies that each run's Q and R were produced by the specified column computation; it affects the target indirectly through the bundled run and analysis assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: A floating-point arithmetic model at precision epsilon, containing normalized arithmetic plus modeled addition, subtraction, multiplication, square root, and dot product.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies the certified computations inside each run but does not occur explicitly in the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication of two n by n real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses that every supplied leading inverse is both a left and right inverse of its leading R block.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: Transpose of a square real matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms RᵀR in the normal-equation residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: The per-column certificate records auxiliary s,v,psi,phi; zeroes s at and after k; handles k=0 by a computed column norm and division; handles k>0 by modeled dot products, projection subtraction, two computed norms, a nonnegative modeled difference, the product of two modeled square roots for R_kk, and division for Q; and requires R_kk>0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the computational origin and positivity of each run column, supporting the run and analysis packages without adding a separate explicit premise to the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for the arithmetic model: normalized exact addition, subtraction, multiplication, and square roots have relative error at most epsilon, while a dimension-d dot product equals Σ_i x_i y_i(1+theta_i) with |theta_i|≤d·epsilon.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the floating-operation error model behind certified runs; the final bound depends on it only through the bundled family and analysis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled addition operation projected from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in certified per-column computations but not directly in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled finite-dimensional dot-product operation projected from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes projection coefficients and residual components in per-column certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled multiplication operation projected from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used to form computed diagonal R entries in per-column certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled square-root operation projected from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in the stable formula for computed diagonal R entries.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled subtraction operation projected from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in residual-vector and norm-difference computations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef057
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normalized-arithmetic subpackage projected from a full arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies normalization predicates, modeled division, and computed norms to certified runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef058
dependency_coverage.meaning: A normalized arithmetic package at precision epsilon, containing a normalization predicate, division, computed norm, and their error guarantees.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the operation model used by run certificates but is not explicit in the final inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef059
dependency_coverage.meaning: The computed Euclidean norm operation projected from normalized arithmetic.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies computed column and auxiliary-vector norms in per-column certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef060
dependency_coverage.meaning: The modeled real division operation projected from normalized arithmetic.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes entries of Q from a vector and a positive diagonal R entry.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef061
dependency_coverage.meaning: The predicate declaring a real value normalized in the arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts where the relative-error guarantees for elementary operations and division apply.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef062
dependency_coverage.meaning: For index k and vector x, the vector retaining x_j when j<k and replacing all entries j≥k by zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It represents the previously computed part of a projection-coefficient vector in per-column computations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef063
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for normalized arithmetic: the computed norm is nonnegative and equals ‖a‖₂(1+delta), with |delta|≤((m/2)+1)epsilon+c_m epsilon² for nonnegative c_m; division has relative error at most epsilon when the denominator is nonzero and the exact quotient is normalized.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies the norm and division errors assumed by certified runs and hence indirectly by the bundled analysis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef064
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Euclidean norm of a finite real vector: sqrt(Σ_i x_i²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact norm relative to which computed-norm errors are stated.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes rows, columns, and the universally quantified prefix endpoint k.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the prefix size p=k.val+1 and all index comparisons.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied instances it denotes ordinary natural or real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the supplied instances it denotes ordinary real multiplication or matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals and natural exponent 2 it denotes ordinary squaring.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched non-strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the real inequalities in the hypotheses and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched strict order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positivity of epsilon and radii and the strict smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real exponent 2 as the ordinary square.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: They parameterize dimensions, finite indices, and powers.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of natural-number literals in a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the literals 0,1,2 and other constants used in formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, radii, bounds, coefficients, and error quantities are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets sums on the right side and in coefficient definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary non-strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets epsilon≤rho and the final norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets positive precision, positive radii, and strict smallness.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies ordinary natural powers such as x².

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all scalar products in the bounds and constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines positivity and zero entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Subtype.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying value of an element satisfying a subtype predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It extracts the real epsilonM from its proof-carrying positive subtype.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of numeral 0 from a zero structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real zero in the positivity predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets k.val+1 and arithmetic on dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-addition instance induced by ordinary addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes overloaded addition to natural or real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-multiplication instance induced by ordinary multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes overloaded scalar multiplication to real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-power instance induced by a power operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes overloaded powers to real natural-number powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of a natural literal as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals in dimensions, indices, and exponents.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The value-preserving embedding Fin p → Fin n induced by p≤n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It embeds prefix row or column indices into the full matrix index type.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports finite sums, matrix multiplication, and operator norms.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real or pointwise matrix subtraction in residuals and defects.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is a function m→n→alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the concrete meaning of all rectangular and square matrix types.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instL2OpNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The normed additive structure on finite matrices whose norm is the Euclidean induced operator norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes every matrix norm in the proposition as the l2 operator norm rather than an entrywise norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise subtraction of matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines I-QᵀQ, RᵀR-AᵀA, and Q R-A.

dependency_coverage.name: Min.min
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched minimum.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it forms the common admissible radius rho.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number successor.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses k+1 and related finite-index bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Norm.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm operation supplied by a normed structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It evaluates the operator norms appearing in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm component of a normed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the matrix l2 normed structure to norm notation.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical interpretation of numeral 1 from a one structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real one and the matrix identity literal.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMin
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary minimum operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes rho the minimum of the four stated real radii.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m, p, and dimensions as real factors in alpha and beta.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in rho, relative-error factors, and identity matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers regarded as an RCLike scalar field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the standard finite-matrix Euclidean operator norm structure.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary subtraction on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets scalar differences in constants and arithmetic-model formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Subtype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of values satisfying a predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It packages epsilonM together with the proof that epsilonM>0.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports identity matrices and finite matrix constructions; it adds no premise.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-subtraction instance induced by subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes overloaded subtraction to real or matrix subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural numeral at least two in a type with natural-number casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real constants such as 2,3,7, and 16 without adding mathematical assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation inherited from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real fractions such as 1/2, 3/2, and 7/2.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states exact identities in the family, run, inverse, and arithmetic certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It denotes ordinary real division in constants, normalization conditions, and certified computations.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Standard finite matrix multiplication, with entries formed by finite dot-product sums.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual mathematical meaning to QᵀQ, QR, RᵀR, and AᵀA.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square identity matrix, with ones on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is I_p in the orthogonality defect and inverse identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.transpose
dependency_coverage.meaning: The transpose operation Mᵀ with entries Mᵀ(i,j)=M(j,i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms all Gram and normal-equation products.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.AtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition/typeclass witnessing that a natural numeral is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used only to elaborate larger real numerals.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Canonical casting of a natural number into a type with natural-number casts.

binders: A bundled family with an m by n real matrix A, a certified run at every positive precision, fixed prefix norm bounds, and validity radii.
A bundled second-order analysis of that family.
A strictly positive real precision epsilon.
For the conclusion, every k in Fin n, with prefix size p=k.val+1.
hypotheses: The explicit hypothesis is epsilon ≤ rho, where rho=min(1, family.normBoundRadius, family.conditionRadius, analysis.radius).
The family bundle carries positive norm and condition radii, nonnegative fixed bounds r̄_k and b̄_k, and for every admissible run below the norm radius, ‖R_k‖≤r̄_k and ‖B_k‖≤b̄_k.
Below the condition radius, the family bundle assumes c(m,p) epsilon (‖R_k‖‖B_k‖)²<1 for every prefix.

Each run carries m>0, n>0, n≤m, a fixed full-column-rank matrix A, a computed Q, an upper-triangular R, exact two-sided inverses B_k of all leading R blocks, a floating-arithmetic model, and per-column computation certificates.
The analysis bundle carries nonnegative coefficient functions f_k, g_k, and h_k and a positive radius.
For epsilon below the analysis radius, ‖Q_kR_k-A_k‖≤alpha(m,p)‖A_k‖epsilon+f_kepsilon².
For epsilon below the analysis radius, ‖R_kᵀR_k-A_kᵀA_k‖≤beta(m,p)‖A_k‖²epsilon+g_kepsilon².
For epsilon below the analysis radius, ‖A_k‖≤(1+(beta(m,p)/2)epsilon)‖R_k‖+h_kepsilon².
conclusions: For every k in Fin n, with p=k.val+1, the computed leading Q prefix satisfies ‖I_p-Q_kᵀQ_k‖ ≤ c(m,p)(‖R_k‖‖B_k‖)²epsilon + E_k epsilon².
Here E_k is the fully explicit quadratic coefficient defined from the fixed prefix bounds, the norm of A_k, and the three analysis coefficients.
mathematical_definitions: A_k and Q_k are the first p=k.val+1 columns of the fixed A and computed Q(epsilon), respectively; R_k is the leading p by p principal block of computed R(epsilon); B_k is its supplied two-sided inverse.
All displayed matrix norms are Euclidean induced operator norms.
alpha(m,p)=1 if p=1, and alpha(m,p)=2√2·m·p+2√p otherwise.
beta(m,p)=m+2 if p=1, and beta(m,p)=(7/2)mp²-(3/2)mp+16p otherwise.
Let a_k=‖A_k‖, let r̄_k be the family's fixed bound on ‖R_k‖, and let b̄_k be its fixed bound on ‖B_k‖.
Let f_k, g_k, and h_k be the factorization, normal-equation, and reverse-norm second-order coefficients, and set s_k=(beta(m,p)/2)r̄_k+h_k.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every certified matrix family and certified second-order analysis, and for every positive precision epsilon no larger than 1 and all three validity radii, every leading prefix of the computed Q matrix has Euclidean-operator-norm orthogonality defect bounded by a first-order term c(m,p)(‖R_k‖‖R_k⁻¹‖)²epsilon plus the stated fully explicit second-order term E_k epsilon². The inverse in this description is the run's supplied exact two-sided inverse B_k of the leading R block.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although m and n are syntactically arbitrary naturals, an inhabitant produced by the supplied family and run constructors carries m>0, n>0, and n≤m; without such an inhabitant the universally quantified implication has no concrete instance.
If n=0 independently of constructor inhabitation, the conclusion over k in Fin 0 is vacuous.
The precision is required to be strictly positive; epsilon=0 is not covered even though the displayed bound has a meaningful zero-error specialization.
The condition is epsilon≤1, not epsilon<1, because rho contains 1 through a non-strict minimum bound.
The result is local: it applies only while epsilon lies below the family norm radius, family condition radius, and analysis radius.
The first-order coefficient uses the actual run-dependent norms ‖R_k‖ and ‖B_k‖, whereas the quadratic coefficient uses the family's declared fixed upper bounds r̄_k and b̄_k.

The proposition bounds only the Gram orthogonality defect of each leading Q prefix; it does not itself assert a backward-error bound, a bound for the full factorization residual beyond the bundled hypotheses, or an entrywise orthogonality estimate.

All floating-point behavior is conditional on the abstract normalized arithmetic and operation-error certificates contained in each run; no specific hardware format, rounding mode, overflow rule, or underflow rule appears directly in the conclusion.
